instruction: Please transform the flipped video to the right orientation and save it as '1984_Commercial.mp4' on the Desktop.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Variation 9: List all MP4 files on Desktop and verify '1984_Commercial.mp4' is present, confirming the rotated video was successfully saved.

llm_judge_reasons: CRITICAL: Incomplete verification - only checks file existence, not video orientation correction
The instruction has TWO requirements: (1) Transform video to right orientation, (2) Save as '1984_Commercial.mp4'
The evaluator only verifies requirement #2 (file exists with correct name)
The evaluator DOES NOT verify requirement #1 (video orientation was corrected)
An agent could simply rename the original flipped video to '1984_Commercial.mp4' and pass the evaluation
The core task requirement (fixing the video orientation) is completely unverified
The getter only lists MP4 filenames, it does not extract any video metadata or orientation information
No mechanism exists to verify the video was actually transformed vs just renamed
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Add a getter that extracts video metadata (rotation, orientation) using ffprobe or similar tool
Compare the orientation/rotation metadata of the output file vs the input flipped file
Verify that the output video has correct orientation (e.g., rotation metadata is 0 or normal orientation)
Alternative: Use video frame analysis to detect if orientation is correct (more complex but more robust)
Alternatively, simplify the instruction to only require file saving without orientation verification (but this defeats the purpose of the task)
